prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE premium hand-painted detailed 2D fighting-game P0 environment depth background for a Predator fan game. Landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024 if possible. Full opaque image, one continuous scene, no panels.
Game reference: Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000. Setting: Intérieur d'un vaisseau spatial, lieu-type confirmé ; aucun nom de vaisseau attribué.
Scene identity: Long volume pressurisé de vaisseau, nervures de coque cintrées, cloisons répétées et fond technique obscur ; pas de baie planétaire inventée comme preuve.
Composition reference: Coursive élargie de duel, deux cadres de cloison reculés ; conduites au-dessus et sous le sol, sans collision implicite.
Render ONLY distant and medium-depth environment. The fight floor, collision and foreground props will be rendered separately: no massive foreground floor slab or close-up objects baked into the image. Keep the lower central third visually quiet and unobstructed, with moderate contrast suitable behind two fighters.
Camera: strict straight-on side elevation across the scene for a side-scrolling duel; level horizon, upright verticals, no tilted camera, no first-person weapon or deep central vanishing-point corridor. Detailed painterly game illustration, grounded functional architecture, natural proportions, atmospheric depth, restrained material highlights, no plastic 3D look and no low-detail CSS-like shapes.
Art direction palette (a proposed adaptation, not a measured reference): background #111522, material #343d49, restrained accents #83b3c6.
Use only the location identity described. This is a newly painted 2D adaptation, not a screenshot and not a certified exact reconstruction. Do not invent famous franchise landmarks or attach names of missions/vehicles not specified.
Must contain NO people, Predators, aliens, animals, bodies, silhouettes of characters, readable text, numbers, signs, letters, logos, watermarks, HUD, interface, borders, collage, montage or texture atlas. Doors and machinery, if present, remain in background and do not block the quiet center.
Unverified geometry remains original design; do not treat these as canonical details: Identité du vaisseau; Forme des nervures; Consoles; Disposition des cloisons.
